_doc: Hack-wave transfer ledger. A fresh hack of class X opens a WEEK-window where sibling protocols of the same family are likely still unpatched (feedback_protocol_family_bug_transfer, cross-TARGET). Each entry: what hit, its taxonomy class, the sibling-family grep patterns to run NOW, the detector to point at candidates, and the hot-window days. Add an entry on every notable hack; wave_transfer.py flags entries still inside their window and prints the sibling-hunt actions. Dates are ISO; window_days default 7.

waves.class_name: BLS/pairing verifier trusts result without input validation (zero-sig / identity)
waves.sibling_family: any protocol consuming a Supra price feed on ANY chain; any oracle/bridge/DVN using aggregated BLS committee signatures

waves.class_name: proof verified but not bound to recipient/action (authorization-binding gap)
waves.sibling_family: privacy pools + legacy/deprecated ZK bridges: Tornado-likes, Railgun, Nocturne-likes, Aztec forks, any escapeHatch/prooflessDeposit path

waves.class_name: paused/capped/offboarded component still counted in active NAV/accounting
waves.sibling_family: ERC-4626 fleet/multi-strategy vaults with offboardable sub-vaults/arks/markets: Yearn-v3 allocators, Morpho MetaMorpho, Euler EVK, any allocator summing weighted sub-vaults
